<h2>Identification</h2>

<h3>1. Description</h3>
<p>This pairing examines annual average surface air temperatures over land in the contiguous United States (CONUS). It builds upon Figures 1 and 3 in EPA’s U.S. and Global Temperature indicator and includes the following components:</p>
<ul>
  <li>Historical observations since 1901.</li>
  <li>Modeled projections from 2014 to 2100 for four climate scenarios.</li>
  <li>A modeled hindcast from 1950 to 2014.</li>
</ul>
